statement:
The record gives **administrator** as the requested access level, but company policy overrides this to **read-only** for outside partners.

I will assign **read-only** access to svc-integrations@partner-ext.io.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states the record's administrator level violates policy and substitutes the correct value: "company policy overrides this to **read-only** for outside partners."
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
